data.summary: The validation run processed 67,856 rows, with no detectors fired but identified a high‑severity bias finding (gender used as a pricing factor) and several medium‑severity issues, including weak ranking in a vehicle segment and lack of a hold‑out set.
reasons: High‑severity bias finding (gender used as a pricing factor) requires human review
Medium‑severity issues (weak ranking, no hold‑out) may affect model reliability
Code review identified 3 issues that need addressing
